vibe_rationale: Flagship Indonesian sneaker and urban-culture show with its own media arm, but convention-hall scale and telco, bank and car sponsors make it sponsor-heavy.
fit_notes: Telco, bank and car partners show non-endemic brands are welcome, and the move to a broader lifestyle market leaves room for wellness. The 2026 presenting partner is not yet named and no partnership contact is published. Jakarta-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
